Your host chooses the draw rule when cre: Your host chooses the draw rule when creating the table. Free drawing allows drawing even with a matching tile; otherwise you must play when you can. The rule stays fixed throughout the match. Draw from the market: two tiles per draw for two players, one for three, none for four. Drawing keeps your turn. You can pass only when you have no matching tile and the market is empty (or there is no market). If everyone passes, the lowest hand pip total wins; a tie goes to the earliest player in the table order.

Open ends score in fives. Round bonuses: Open ends score in fives. Round bonuses are rounded to the nearest five. First to 365 wins.
Each player receives seven tiles. Round: Each player receives seven tiles. Round one opens with 2–3 and scores five. Redeal if 2–3 is in the market. Later rounds open with any tile, played by the previous round winner.
After each placement, add all exposed en: After each placement, add all exposed ends. A positive multiple of five scores that total immediately. An exposed double counts both halves. Unused side branches count zero.
Any double connected on both normal side: Any double connected on both normal sides may take a sideways tile, but opening that branch must score a multiple of five. Match its number; later tiles can extend the branch normally. Each double has two side branches.
